question: Should OpenClaw add a public reset-start prompt override, and if so should it live under top-level `session`, under `agents.defaults` plus `agents.list[]`, or be folded into the broader reset-greeting policy?
rationale: Adding this request creates new public config surface in a session/startup path; repository policy sets a high bar for new config keys and current code has adjacent startup-context and reset-greeting work that need one canonical owner.

options.title: Add a narrow prompt override
options.body: Expose one canonical reset-start prompt field at the chosen owner boundary, keep current behavior as fallback, and cover global/per-agent behavior only if maintainers want fleet overrides.

options.title: Fold into greeting policy
options.body: Track this under the broader reset greeting model/suppress policy so prompt text, model choice, and silence behavior are decided together.

options.title: Use hooks/plugins only
options.body: Decline a config key and document the existing hook/plugin escape hatch for operators willing to maintain code-level customization.

recommendation.title: Add a narrow prompt override
recommendation.body: Expose one canonical reset-start prompt field at the chosen owner boundary, keep current behavior as fallback, and cover global/per-agent behavior only if maintainers want fleet overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: The current reset prompt, command, and schema lines are all tied to this recent area history.
